title: aster puniceus subsp. elliottii
intro: Aster puniceus subsp. elliottii, commonly known as Elliott's Purple-stemmed Aster or Purple-stemmed Aster, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aster puniceus subsp. elliottii are thought to be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
